title: ELV Design Engineer
description:
**1. Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. ELV System Design & Engineering**

* Design and prepare ELV system layouts as per project specifications and client requirements.
* Develop detailed engineering drawings for various ELV systems.
* Review architectural, electrical and MEP drawings to identify ELV requirements.
* Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards and project specifications.
* Prepare system architecture, schematic diagrams and block diagrams.
* Select suitable equipment, devices and technical solutions based on project requirements.

**B. ELV Systems Knowledge**

The candidate should have working knowledge of the following systems:

L-Vision Segurança Eletrônica | Monitoramento e Automação

**1. CCTV Surveillance System**

* Camera layouts, coverage and positioning.
* Camera selection, NVR, storage and network architecture.
* CCTV schematic and connectivity drawings.

Awa Tech Company

**2. Access Control System**

* Door access control layouts.
* Readers, controllers, electromagnetic locks and exit devices.
* Door-wise wiring and system architecture.

**3. Fire Alarm System**

* Fire alarm device layouts.
* Loop diagrams and wiring schematics.
* Panel sizing and device quantity calculations.

Contemporary Controls Delivers Custom Solution for Room Climate Automation - Contemporary Controls (EMEA)

**4. Building Management System (BMS)**

* BMS architecture and network topology.
* DDC panel layouts and controller selection.
* I/O point schedules and control schematics.
* Integration with HVAC, electrical and other systems.

結構化佈線：以ANSI/TIA/EIA-568為參考主要標準 | 雷勵資通科技

**5. Structured Cabling & Networking**

* Data and voice layouts.
* Rack layouts and network architecture.
* Cable routing, connectivity and patch panel schedules.

【EN54 Voice Evacuation System】Shopping Mall in Abu Dhabi - Guangzhou DSPPA Audio Co., Ltd.

**6. Public Address & Voice Evacuation**

* Speaker layouts and zoning.
* Amplifier sizing and speaker load calculations.
* System schematics and cable routing.

**C. Drawing Preparation & Documentation**

* Prepare AutoCAD drawings, including:
* Design basis drawings.
* Layout and installation drawings.
* Shop drawings and coordination drawings.
* Schematic and riser diagrams.
* System architecture diagrams.
* Cable routing and containment layouts.
* As-built drawings.
* Prepare equipment schedules and device location schedules.
* Incorporate consultant and client comments into drawings.
* Maintain drawing revisions and submission records.

**D. BOQ & Material Estimation**

* Prepare detailed Bill of Quantities (BOQ).
* Conduct material take-offs based on approved drawings.
* Prepare cable length calculations and device quantity schedules.
* Prepare technical specifications and material submittals.
* Support the estimation and tendering team in technical proposals.
* Coordinate with procurement for equipment selection and technical compliance.

**E. Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate with architects, MEP consultants, electrical and HVAC design teams.
* Attend design coordination meetings with clients and consultants.
* Resolve design clashes and technical queries.
* Review site requirements and provide engineering support to project execution teams.
* Coordinate with OEMs and vendors for technical selections and approvals.

**F. Standards & Compliance**

* Ensure drawings and designs comply with applicable project specifications.
* Follow relevant NFPA, NBC, TIA, ISO and applicable IEC standards, wherever relevant to the system.
* Ensure proper device coverage, cable sizing and equipment selection.
* Review technical specifications and consultant requirements.
